1: // Simple Cosmic Dodge game
2: // Canvas with id="game"
3: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
5: canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
6: canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
7: 
8: // Player (triangle ship)
9: const player = {
10:   x: canvas.width / 2,
11:   y: canvas.height - 30,
12:   size: 20, // ship size (length of base)
13:   speed: 4,
14:   color: '#0ff',
15:   shield: false,
16:   shieldTimer: 0,
17: };
18: 
19: // Stars for background
20: // Sound effects
21: const sounds = {
22:   // collision sound (game over)
23:   collision: new Audio('https://www.soundjay.com/button/sounds/button-10.wav'),
24:   // shield block sound
25:   shield: new Audio('https://www.soundjay.com/button/sounds/button-09.wav'),
26:   // power‑up collect sound
27:   powerup: new Audio('https://www.soundjay.com/button/sounds/button-16.wav'),
28:   // background music (loop)
29:   bg: new Audio('https://www.soundjay.com/misc/sounds/bell-ringing-01.mp3')
30: };
31: sounds.bg.loop = true;
32: sounds.bg.volume = 0.2;
33: sounds.bg.play();
34: const stars = [];
35: for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
36:   stars.push({
37:     x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
38:     y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
39:     radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
40:   });
41: }
42: 
43: // Asteroids
44: const asteroids = [];
45: const asteroidSpawnRate = 90; // frames
46: let frameCount = 0;
47: 
48: // Power‑ups (simple shield)
49: const powerUps = [];
50: const powerUpSpawnRate = 600;
51: 
52: // Input handling
53: const keys = {};
54: window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {keys[e.key] = true;});
55: window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {keys[e.key] = false;});
56: 
57: function updatePlayer() {
58:   if (keys.ArrowUp || keys.w) player.y -= player.speed;
59:   if (keys.ArrowDown || keys.s) player.y += player.speed;
60:   if (keys.ArrowLeft || keys.a) player.x -= player.speed;
61:   if (keys.ArrowRight || keys.d) player.x += player.speed;
62:   // keep inside canvas
63:   player.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width - player.size, player.x));
64:   player.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.height - player.size, player.y));
65:   if (player.shield) {
66:     player.shieldTimer--;
67:     if (player.shieldTimer <= 0) player.shield = false;
68:   }
69: }
70: 
71: function spawnAsteroid() {
72:   const size = Math.random() * 30 + 10;
73:   const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - size);
74:   const speed = Math.random() * 2 + 1;
75:   asteroids.push({x, y: -size, size, speed});
76: }
77: 
78: function updateAsteroids() {
79:   for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
80:     const a = asteroids[i];
81:     a.y += a.speed;
82:     if (a.y > canvas.height) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
83:   }
84: }
85: 
86: function spawnPowerUp() {
87:   const size = 15;
88:   const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - size);
89:   const y = -size;
90:   const speed = 2;
91:   powerUps.push({x, y, size, speed});
92: }
93: 
94: function updatePowerUps() {
95:   for (let i = powerUps.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
96:     const p = powerUps[i];
97:     p.y += p.speed;
98:     if (p.y > canvas.height) powerUps.splice(i, 1);
99:   }
100: }
101: 
102: function checkCollisions() {
103:   // Asteroid collisions
104:   for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
105:     const a = asteroids[i];
106:     if (
107:       player.x < a.x + a.size &&
108:        player.x + player.size > a.x &&
109:       player.y < a.y + a.size &&
110:        player.y + player.size > a.y
111:     ) {
112: if (player.shield) {
113:           // shield blocks asteroid
114:           sounds.shield.play();
115:           asteroids.splice(i, 1);
116:         } else {
117:           // collision ends game
118:           sounds.collision.play();
119:           gameOver();
120:           return;
121:         }
122:     }
123:   }
124:   // Power‑up collisions
125:   for (let i = powerUps.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
126:     const p = powerUps[i];
127:     if (
128:       player.x < p.x + p.size &&
129:        player.x + player.size > p.x &&
130:       player.y < p.y + p.size &&
131:        player.y + player.size > p.y
132:     ) {
133:       player.shield = true;
134:       player.shieldTimer = 300; // frames
135:       powerUps.splice(i, 1);
136:     }
137:   }
138: }
139: 
140: let running = true;
141: 
142: function updateStars() {
143:   for (let i = 0; i < stars.length; i++) {
144:     const s = stars[i];
145:     s.y += 0.5;
146:     if (s.y > canvas.height) {
147:       s.y = 0;
148:       s.x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
149:     }
150:   }
151: }
152: function gameOver() {
153:   running = false;
154:   ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
155:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
156:   ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
157:   ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
158:   ctx.textAlign = 'center';
159:   ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
160: }
161: 
162: function draw() {
163:   ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
164:   // player
165:   ctx.fillStyle = player.shield ? '#ff0' : player.color;
166:   ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.width, player.height);
167:   // asteroids
168:   ctx.fillStyle = '#777';
169:   asteroids.forEach(a => ctx.fillRect(a.x, a.y, a.size, a.size));
170:   // power‑ups
171:   ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
172:   powerUps.forEach(p => ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, p.size, p.size));
173: }
174: 
175: function loop() {
176:   if (!running) return;
177:   frameCount++;
178:   updatePlayer();
179:   if (frameCount % asteroidSpawnRate === 0) spawnAsteroid();
180:   if (frameCount % powerUpSpawnRate === 0) spawnPowerUp();
181:   updateAsteroids();
182:   updatePowerUps();
183:   checkCollisions();
184:   draw();
185:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
186: }
187: 
188: // start game
189: requestAnimationFrame(loop);
